Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

ornament noun

also decoration, adornment, equipment, trappings, a distinction

classical

Caes. BG 7.15: quae praesidiō et ōrnāmentō est cīvitātī (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BC 2.18: pecūniam, omniaque ōrnāmenta ex fānō Herculis in oppidum contulit (Lewis & Short)

ōrnāmentum, ōrnāmentī n.

noun, second declension

equipment, trappings; an ornament, a decoration; a distinction

Examples

  • pecūniam, omniaque ōrnāmenta ex fānō Herculis in oppidum contulit

    he brought the money and all the ornaments from the shrine of Hercules into the townCaes. BC 2.18 (Lewis & Short)

See also decorate.
